create.name: Kelly Smith
create.bio:
Kelly Smith is a meditation and yoga teacher who runs Yoga For You and presents Mindful in Minutes, a long-running podcast of guided meditations that are mostly twenty minutes or shorter. She first did yoga as a teenager to support her sport, and it took on a deeper meaning for her during a hard family time at sixteen. She enrolled in her first teacher training straight after university and has since taught for well over a decade, holding E-RYT 500 and YACEP status and leading trainings and retreats on several continents.

Her approach favours the quieter practices: meditation, yoga nidra, restorative yoga and gentle mindful movement, offered as adaptable tools for ordinary, busy lives. Much of her work now trains others to teach, through online meditation and restorative yoga trainings with continuing-education hours, alongside private sessions by video call and small-group retreats. Her two books in the Mindful in Minutes series cover meditating as a family and stepping back from one's thoughts, and there is also a meditation card deck. She still records many of her practices at home for the podcast, YouTube and Insight Timer.

courses.title: Online Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: Kelly's online training for people who want to teach meditation, with live sessions, recordings and continuing-education hours registered with Yoga Alliance. A payment plan is offered.

courses.title: Restorative Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A 20-hour training in teaching restorative yoga, the slow, prop-supported practice of rest she most loves to teach.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Kelly
courses.description: One-hour sessions on Zoom for meditation or yoga instruction, or mentoring for teachers and podcasters. A personal recorded meditation can be added.

free_resources.title: Mindful in Minutes (podcast)
free_resources.description: Kelly's free podcast of guided meditations, most of them twenty minutes or less, with occasional conversations. Available on all the main podcast apps and YouTube.

free_resources.title: Kelly Smith on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, with guided meditations and yoga nidra. The tracks are free to play.
